assessments.reasoning: Printed p. xli describes job control in z/OS and separately enumerates JCL statements and JES2 and JES3 JECL. Printed p. 1 explicitly names MVS Job Control Language and distinguishes its statement table from the JECL table on p. 2.

challenge.method: Read the archive title and dated edition leaf, pp. xli and 1, and Table 2 on p. 2. Compare the same-order-number entry on IBM's public publication index and the contents of the three complete pinned specimens.
challenge.results: The February book documents one named MVS job-control language on the z/OS platform. The independent acquisition reproduced HTTP 403 on IBM's PDF route. The public index identifies July 2025 separately. The two dates and exact source provenance are distinct.

limitations: The evidence establishes the language identity recorded in the February 24, 2025 issue. The July file, other JCL languages, JES interfaces, embedded command languages, and implementation results remain outside the claim.
